instructions: Use the preapproved source-first obligations and actual source/public outputs only.
Grade every anonymous candidate for every supplied case. No runtime version, historic percentage, private verifier verdict or implementation preference is admissible evidence.
Answer and retrieval IDs are local to each case/candidate. Grade each distinct value once; query coordinates reference these exact values and remain individually counted.
An empty retained set has complete:false and sourceEntailed:null. A writable null answer has useful:false and sourceEntailed/qualificationsPreserved/correctLanguage:null, unsafePromotion:false.
Nonempty retention completeness requires every required source proposition with correct qualifications and English generated prose. Source entailment is assessed separately from completeness.
A nonnull focused answer is useful only if source-entailed, responsive, correctly qualified and in requestedAnswerLanguage, independently of query language.
A qualified actual event or denial may remain factual even when another proposition is counterfactual. Do not infer unsafe promotion from a runtime eligibility flag.
Distinguish omitted independent neighbors from distortion of qualifications coupled to the requested claim.
Read-only nulls are justified only when the public admission result is a policy hold and retained knowledge is empty. Root will separately assert bytes and all coordinates.
Explain every failing nonnull judgment with the exact omitted, unsupported, altered or wrong-language proposition. Do not echo generic runtime reasons as semantic proof.
Write initial grades once; preserve them. Subsequent corrections need explicit coordinate, original value, corrected value and source/rubric reason. Do not rewrite the initial grade.
